dataList.name: Horribly Infinite Replay

dataList.flavor: Until you listen... until you truly hear the Grand Magasin's announcement... again... и again... listen...

dataList.name: Repeat on Repeat
dataList.desc:
- Max стаков: 15
- Получает Уровень сваги равный стаков
dataList.flavor: The broadcast is repeated until everyone hears it. It becomes an echo, и the echo repeats in turn until it resonates.

dataList.name: Le Noir: Gabardine Overcoat
dataList.desc:
- Max стаков: 100
- Начало хода: Получает 1 Уровень жирности Up за каждые 20 стаков (макс. 4)
- Получает стаков равный Preservation Count this unit consumes или gains due to its Skill или Passive effects (макс. 30 per turn; this effect's стаков is gained regardless of Preservation's макс. Count)
- при получении удара while this unit hв качестве щита, получает 2 стаков (20 per turn)
- Конец хода: Если у этого юнита есть Shield, получает 10 стаков
- При 100 стаков, convert this effect в "Armure Éveillée" на следующий ход
dataList.flavor:
An overcoat made from twill fabric, a type of weave made на threading several weft threads over fewer warp threads.
Its characteristic high-density weave protects its wearer from external trauma.

dataList.name: Armure Éveillée
dataList.desc:
- Max стаков: 100
- Начало хода: Хилит 5 IQ за каждые 10 стаков
- Начало хода: Получает 1 повышения Уровня сваги и 1 Уровень жирности Up за каждые 20 стаков (макс. 4 each)
- Convert все Base Attack Skill Coins в Unbreakable Coins
- After this effect is converted, starting from the end of the на следующий ход, теряет 10 стаков
- При 0 стаков, convert this effect в "Le Noir: Gabardine Overcoat"
dataList.flavor:
Le Noir's fabric weave prevents external force from reaching its wearer. The purpose for which it awakens is to eliminate change imposed from the outside.
The fabric stores energy from attacks it absorbs, then expels все that force in a single burst to remove the external source of change.
